narrative: Material PL3__M33A264B exhibits intermittent-lumpy demand with only 31.8% of working days showing positive demand and a high coefficient of variation of 1.33, indicating sporadic but occasionally large consumption events. Lead times are moderately unstable (CV=0.93) based on 3 observations ranging from 0.5 to 2.79 days. An (r,Q) policy with MOQ-constrained order quantity of 526 units and a safety stock of 11 units is recommended to achieve the 95% service level target while utilizing only 35.8% of available storage capacity. The slight downward demand trend warrants periodic policy review every 86 days.
warnings: EOQ (136.8) is below MOQ (526); order quantity set to MOQ
Only 3 lead time observations available; lead time statistics have high uncertainty
Downward demand trend detected; policy should be reviewed quarterly

research_insights.selection_rationale: Intermittent-lumpy demand with low mean and high CV is best served by a continuous-review (r,Q) policy that triggers a fixed replenishment when stock drops to the reorder point, avoiding over-ordering while maintaining service level. The MOQ of 526 naturally defines Q, making a variable-order policy (s,S) unnecessarily complex here.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Order quantity is MOQ-constrained at 526 (EOQ=137), resulting in infrequent large orders (~2.9/year). This increases cycle stock holding cost but is unavoidable given the supplier MOQ. Capacity utilisation at 35.8% is well within limits with no capacity-driven risk.
